Difftest UIPainting_Run (2000 seeds; every 3rd through the creators (original 0x6c1e61 against ours), the others the original constructor on 0xc5 memory against ours; 1-12 random operations per seed through each side's own vtables: Init, Shutdown, QueryInterface / AddRef / Release on every face with known and unknown ids, every painting slot with its inputs around their edges (lot kinds 1 / 2 / 0 / 3 / -1, null names and colour pointers, 0-5 lots with null entries and names differing in case; 0-3 layers with null images, scales giving fractional sizes, every alignment; images 0-3 pixels wide / tall with transparent pixels and refused locks; texture names in and out of the manager's cache; thumbnail sources with and without their own thumbnail, dirty and clean ids, the lot and render routes; numbers 0, +-1, INT32_MIN / MAX; texts empty to longer than the small-string buffer, sizes 0..0x1000 with 255 / 256 / 257 and 512 x 510 around the font's scaling), messages 0xc5 / 0xc7 / others with and without the standard face and data words; every getter cell present or null; the last Release destroys it; after each step the result, the colours written, the event log (the strings, rectangles and colours by content), every field (the colour cache in order, the id sets, the overlay) and every fake's count compared). Mutation check (lane KV, after the fakes were given the game bodies' argument counts): 38 mutants over every function, 34 killed, 4 argued equivalent: the ceil correction of the scaled text height (it only changes an exact odd height, where (256 - h) >> 1 is the same either way); white.g for white.b (the constant is (1, 1, 1); white.b * 0.25 is killed); textWidth >= 0x100 (factor 1 there changes nothing; > 0x101 is killed); KS's 5 + 1 split of the slot 32 / 18 calls in CreateTextTexture (in this build the outer call takes the inner one's leftover push as its second argument, so the machine behaviour is identical; the other three wrong splits, 21 / 33 twice, 30 / 52 and 10 / 59, are killed).
